galleryDescription: Explore six editable pixel art projects. Inspect tiles, compare palettes, step through animation frames and download the source files.
galleryIntro: Explore the artwork frame by frame. Each project includes editable source files.
sceneAlt: A wooden bridge crosses the water to a lantern-lit glasshouse.
facadeAlt: The glass dome, iron ribs and lantern-lit doorway of the conservatory
tilesAlt: Shoreline, water, building and planting tiles used in the scene
sceneStory: Glass, iron and lamplight sit on separate layers. Twelve façade tiles fit together with the shoreline, reeds and bridge to build a new map.
courierStill: Still frame of the Alpine Post Courier
animationError: The animation could not load. Download the project to open it in the local player.
courierStory: In profile, the mailbag peeks out behind the coat. Body and bag rise one pixel as the feet pass. The scarf has its own layer so its swing can be adjusted independently.
machineStill: Still frame of the wind observatory
machineStory: The wind cups accelerate and the needle sweeps across the dial. During sampling, bubbles rise through the glass cylinder.
iconsAlt: A brass compass, sample bottle, tongs, chart, buoy, lens, sample case and shell
duskAlt: Eight survey icons in the blue and violet dusk palette
iconsStory: Eight instruments share fifteen opaque colors. Switch to dusk and the compass needle and lens reflections stay in exactly the same pixels.
keeperStory: Turn the keeper around and switch outfits to see how the storm cape covers the shoulders and back.
atlasError: The player could not load. Download the pack to inspect the original atlas.
keeperMotion: 4 directions · 1 idle and 4 walk frames each
keeperLayers: Separate cape layer · four original layers match frame by frame
keeperFiles: Character, cape, props, local edits and sprite sheets
keeperReplay: Rebuilding with rc.6 reproduced the SHA-256 hashes of all four sprite sheets. Check timing, pivots and import settings in your game.
keeperSheetAlt: Four rows of facings, each with one idle pose and four walk frames
keeperSheetData: 5 columns × 4 rows · PNG and JSON included
capeBack: Rear view wearing the storm cape
capeDifference: The cape adds one layer to the same character.
nezhaStory: The front foot lands before the spear extends. The red sash settles a few frames later.
nezhaLayers: Sash, legs and wheels, torso, arms and spear
nezhaFiles: Editable project, 6 × 2 sheet, atlas JSON and transparent APNG
credit: AI-assisted artwork · CC BY 4.0 · PixelForge / starcloud530
homeDescription: Inspect and download original pixel environments, animated sprites and palette studies made with the PixelForge CLI.
heroCopy: We drew the glasshouse in one piece, then cut it into 12 tiles for the map.
toolCopy: Each project comes with editable PixelForge files. Change a palette, adjust the timing or export a new atlas with the local CLI.
